issue_context.title: Add switcher for AutoScaler in disaggregated-tiflash mode
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Originally, tidb fetch topo of tiflash_compute from PD when dispatching MPPTask. this pr https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/40729 add **TopoFetcher** to fetch topo from AutoScaler.

We need to add a switcer to fallback to old mode(fetch topo from PD) in case something bad happen in prod env.
